title: Engagement Doctrine Schema
description: Validates doctrine.json and files exported by the Doctrine builder: the order in which threat types are processed and, for each type, the ordered list of defense systems allowed to engage it.

name.description: Display name shown in the tool's header badge.

typeOrder.description: Threat types in processing order. Magazine spent on an earlier type carries into later types.

engage.description: For each threat type in typeOrder, the defense system ids allowed to engage it, outermost first. A system absent from a list never engages that type.
